description: Make a singing video from one photo and a song: the person in the photo performs the song, filmed from several camera angles and lip-synced. Returns a job id at once. Rendering is slow (a 3-minute video takes about half an hour), so check stork_singing_video_status about once a minute. Paid from Stork credits, 20 credits per second of delivered video ($12.00 a minute); there is no free tier, and a failed video charges nothing. This spends the account's money: call stork_singing_video_estimate first and order once. Needs 'Authorization: Bearer sk_stork_<key>'. Only use faces and songs you have permission to use.

audio_url.description: Public https URL of the song (MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, WebM), at least 15 seconds

image_url.description: Public https URL of a photo with one clear face

seconds.description: Length of video to make from the start of the song, 15 to 330. Default: the whole song.

name: stork_singing_video_create
